CustomField.description: Number of Compliance_Assessment__c checklist items this supplier had at the moment its checklist was first generated/persisted (ScopeCalloutQueueable or VendorPortalController.persistCuratedChecklist) — frozen at that point, not recalculated if items are added later. This is the N in RiskScoreService's per-document scoring (each Compliant document contributes +round(100/N), each Non-Compliant/Rejected contributes a severity-weighted negative share), so a document's point value stays stable even if the checklist is edited afterward.
CustomField.label: Checklist Item Count
